excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]有显著的水体，同时其大陆部分是了无生机的荒漠。已授权进一步研究。
excerpt.en: [Root.GetName] has significant bodies of water, and yet its landmasses are lifeless deserts. Further study is warranted.

triggers.en: Placed on a planet by an event

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]的船员在[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]上的荒芜沙丘上探索时，第一个汇报并不出乎意料：这是一片不自然的废土，在水面以上没有任何的生命迹象。然而，这座行星的水生生命已经远远进化过了我们预期可以涉足陆地的水准。

此外，船员们还发现了一些被黄沙覆盖、外观老旧的似乎是建筑一样的东西。就在他们刚开始向这些表面上的建筑内挖掘时，一小群纳米虫群突触出现，并开始袭击研究人员。似乎这座建筑不是由沙子，而是由无数的微小纳米机器构成的！

启动以后这些虫群很快开始自我复制、唤醒越来越多的休眠群体。[Root.GetLeaderName]下令从行星上紧急撤离，[Root.GetName]才能在最后一刻从这个纳米机器人风暴的穷追不舍中逃离大气层。其他的虫群也被激活了，而且没有停息的迹象。
texts.en:
As the [Root.GetName]s' crew explored the barren dunes of [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName], the first reports were much as expected: this is an unnatural wasteland with no signs of life above the water's surface. Yet the planet's aquatic life has evolved well past the point we would expect some species to make forays onto dry land.

Additionally, the crew discovered what originally appeared to be various ancient-looking, sand-covered structures. Shortly after they began digging into these apparent buildings, small swarms of nanites emerged and began harassing the researchers. It seems the buildings are formed not from sand, but by billions of microscopic nanomachines!

Once mobilized, these swarms quickly multiplied, awakening more and more of the dormant whole. [Root.GetLeaderName] ordered a swift evacuation of the planet, allowing the [Root.GetName] just enough time to escape the atmosphere with a swarming storm of nanites in hot pursuit. The remaining swarm now seems agitated, and it's not calming down.

label.zh: 查查到底发生了什么事。

texts.zh: 帕尔乌斯III没有有机生命，但它仍然充满了活动。这些生物是什么，它们能够被合理解释吗？
texts.en: Parvus III is devoid of organic life, yet it still swarms with activity. What are these creatures and can they be reasoned with?

texts.zh: [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]上的纳米虫群既是一种科学奇迹，又是一个危险。溯其起源及它们与这颗星球独特生态系统的联系对我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]来说是一个使其兴奋的挑战，当然也可潜在地促进我们对机械智能的理解。
texts.en: The nanite swarm on [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName] is both a technological marvel and a danger. Charting the origin of the nanites as well as their relation to the planet's unique ecology provides an exciting challenge for our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] while also potentially advancing our understanding of machine intelligence.

texts.zh: [root.GetName]已经完成了对[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]原生纳米机器人的研究，结果令人难以置信。数千年前，一艘来自先进文明的舰船在此坠毁。那艘船上有几十种不同设计的机器人。
texts.en: The [root.GetName] has completed its study of the nanites native to [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName], and the results are incredible. Thousands of years ago, a ship hailing from an advanced civilization crashed here. Aboard that vessel were robots of dozens different designs.

texts.zh: 令人好奇的是，这些机器人似乎是神秘的“建门者”的工具，比所有我们已知的L-星门都更古老。
texts.en: Curiously, it seems these machines might have been a tool of the mysterious Gate Builders, though older than any L-Gate we have found.

texts.zh: 不管是谁，建造这些机器的人确实掌握了更先进的科技，而且远远地早于我们。
texts.en: Whoever built these machines was in possession of truly advanced technology, long before our time.

texts.zh:
这些机器人自主行动，并尝试按他们的程序保护行星。失去了创造者的规制，一场战斗很快就在这些机器之中爆发了。

这场冲突中胜出的是一群具有超适应性、可自我复制的纳米系统，它们迅速演化适应了行星的生态系统。这些机器将自己变成了行星表面的主宰，将一切当地种群和其他的机器对手全部化为碎屑。

如今我们所见即是这场大战的余波：一个并非了无生机的星球，而是承载着它最顶尖的猎食者。
texts.en:
The robots operated autonomously and attempted to secure the planet according to their programming. Without their creators to rein them in, a battle soon broke out among the machines.

The emerging victor of this conflict was a hyper-adaptive, self-replicating nanite system that rapidly evolved to fit the planet's biosphere. This machine made itself the master of the surface world, breaking down anything from local flora to its former, robotic rivals.

We bear witness to the aftermath of this great war: a planet not devoid of life, but instead supporting its evolved apex predator.

tooltips.zh: 指挥我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]解开[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]上演化出的纳米机器人的秘密。
tooltips.en: Direct our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] to unlock the secrets of the evolved nanites on [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]

texts.zh: 我们对人工智能的进阶科技可以用于重编程并驯服这些纳米机器人。他们可以在这个行星上建造建筑时贡献巨大的力量，而他们与这颗星球的生态系统之间的关联，则可能可以利用来创造一个天堂。
texts.en: Our advanced knowledge of Artificial Intelligence can be used to reprogram and tame the nanites. They could be a great asset in building structures on the planet - and with their link to the world's ecosystem, it should be possible to instruct the nanites to create a paradise.

texts.zh: 我们对人工智能的进阶科技可以用于重编程并驯服这些纳米机器人。他们可以在这个行星上建造建筑时贡献巨大的力量，而他们与这颗星球的生态系统之间的关联，则可能可以利用来创造我们的第二母星。
texts.en: Our advanced knowledge of Artificial Intelligence can be used to reprogram and tame the nanites. They could be a great asset in building structures on the planet - and with their link to the world's ecosystem, it should be possible to instruct the nanites to create a second homeworld.

sections.en: Our advanced knowledge of Artificial Intelligence can be used to reprogram and tame the nanites. They could be a great asset in building structures on the planet - and with their link to the world's ecosystem, it should be possible to instruct the nanites to create a second homeworld.

texts.zh:
尽管[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]的虫群在成为集体时所向披靡，但其个体却相当脆弱。从该行星的大气中抽取出一小部分，并使用我们的先进AI科技，我们成功地重写了这些机器人的通讯系统。当我们将我们重编程过的机器人放回虫群后，这些修改在一瞬间席卷全球。

获得网络的控制后，我们第一要务是为[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]带回稳定的大气，并且要对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]而言最为舒适的那种。这颗行星现在已经充分准备好等待我们的到来，而纳米虫群则会对我们殖民者的需求无所不应。
texts.en:
While the nanite swarm of [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName] was impressive as a collective, as individuals they were quite vulnerable. Extracting a few from the planet's atmosphere and using our advanced AI technology, we have managed to reprogram the communication systems of the machines. Then when we reintroduced our reprogrammed nanites into the swarm, the modifications spread across the globe in a flash.

With control of the network secured, our first order was to reintroduce a stable biosphere onto [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName] - one which is optimized for [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The planet is now ready and waiting for us, and the nanite swarm is prepared to help with any task our colonists may give it.

label.en: Start up the colony ships' engines!

note.zh: 帕尔乌斯III成为宜居星球。

texts.zh: [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName] 的居民令人印象深刻。我们发送到大气层的任何探测器都会虫群迅速分析并拆散，此后不久，虫群的其余部分也学会了如何最好地摧毁我们的无人机——即使是在行星的远端。虫群对我们的技术的理解显着增加。
texts.en: The denizens of [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName] keep impressing. Any probe we send down into the atmosphere is quickly analyzed and taken apart by the swarm, and shortly thereafter the rest of its hive has learned how to best consume our drones as well - even on the far side of the planet. The swarm demonstrates a measurable increase in its understanding of our technology.

texts.zh:
我们的一些[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为，这种行为证明了该虫群是一个智慧的存在，或是某种生物，甚至可能被认为是活着的。

是时候做出决定了：我们是放生它们，还是摧毁它们，还是试图为了我们自己的利益而占据这些存在呢？
texts.en:
Some of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] argue that this behavior is proof that the swarm is a sapient being - or beings - and might even be considered to be alive.

It is time to make a decision: do we let them be, destroy them, or else attempt to appropriate these beings for our own gain?

texts.zh: 这些是正在发育的蜂群行为，如果任其发展，纳米虫群可能会实现智慧。我们是让它保持这种状态，还是在它成为威胁之前将其摧毁？我们能否以某种方式利用这个实体来谋取利益？
texts.en: These are the behaviors of a budding hivemind, and if left to its own devices, the nanite swarm may achieve sapience. Do we leave it in this state, or do we destroy it before it become a threat? Could we somehow appropriate this entity for our gain?

label.zh: 这些不仅仅是自动机器人，而是活物！
label.en: These are not mere automatons, but living beings!

texts.zh: 下令对虫群进行轨道轰炸。如果有任何值得发现的秘密，我们可以从这些害虫的尸体里寻找。
texts.en: Order an orbital bombardment of the swarm. If there are any secrets worth discovering, we will harvest them from the shells of these gnats.

texts.zh:
在[root.fleet.GetName]完成对[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]的轨道轰炸后，尘埃逐渐落定。尽管混合使用了强劲的爆炸物和试验性EMP，轰炸的过程仍然持续了很长，不过最终，这里再也没有任何机械生命活动的迹象了。

我们未来的殖民者可以获取这些害虫的尸体，并有望能从中收获一些有用的东西。
texts.en:
The dust is settling after the [root.fleet.GetName] finished orbital bombardment of [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]. Despite using a mix of powerful explosives and experimental EMPs, the process took a long time - but at last, there is no longer any trace of machine life down there.

Our future colonists will have access to these gnats' remains and will, hopefully, manage to harvest something valuable from them.

summary.text:
# 荒芜的沙漠 / Deserted Desert

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/anomalies/02_anomaly_categories.txt:513-525` · `common/solar_system_initializers/special_system_initializers.txt:1139-1200 (parvus_system)` · `events/anomaly_events_4.txt:1258-1542 (6700-6720)` · `common/special_projects/00_projects_3.txt:1173-1238` · `common/event_chains/00_event_chains.txt:396-400` · `common/scripted_effects/00_scripted_effects.txt:3243-3290`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-12（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 6级异常，不会随机生成：只由特殊星系“帕尔乌斯”的初始化器放在帕尔乌斯III上（spawn_chance 为0）。  
  Level-6 anomaly that never spawns randomly: only the special "Parvus" system initializer places it on Parvus III (spawn_chance 0).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 6700“死里逃生”：沙漠由纳米虫群构成，科研船勉强逃离；行星获纳米虫群修正，开始事件链“帕尔乌斯III的居民”，开启300天项目“研究纳米虫群”（科研船+科学家）。  
  6700 "Narrow Escape": the dunes are nanite swarms; the planet gets the nanite modifier, the chain "The Inhabitants of Parvus III" begins and a 300-day study project opens.
- 6705“纳米机器人的起源”：远古坠毁飞船的机器人内战，胜者是适应生物圈的纳米虫群（若已遇见L星门，文本提到星门建造者）。三选一：驯服（需自觉逻辑科技；300天项目）、继续研究（按科技给予研究/科技，设studied标志并结束事件链）、摧毁（300天项目，舰队战力≥2000）。三个选项都会增加一条L星门线索（遥远群星）。  
  6705 "On the Origin of Nanites": a crashed ship's robots fought until a hyper-adaptive nanite swarm won (with the L-Gate text if one was encountered). Tame (needs Self-Aware Logic; 300-day project), study further (research/tech; sets the studied flag and ends the chain), or destroy (300-day project, fleet power ≥2000). Each option adds an L-Gate clue (Distant Stars).
- 仅“继续研究”后：80–1080天后 6710“人造免疫系统”（需自觉逻辑，全局一次）：再次选择驯服、摧毁或承认它们是生命（物理研究与200影响力，结束事件链）。  
  Only after "study further": 80–1080 days later 6710 "Artificial Immune System" (needs Self-Aware Logic, once): tame, destroy, or recognise them as living beings (physics research and 200 influence, chain ends).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 驯服完成 → 6715：行星改为主物种偏好的星球类型（机械、栖息地等偏好者为盖亚星球），获驯服虫群修正与标本。  
  Taming → 6715: the planet becomes the main species' preferred class (Gaia for mechanical/habitat-type preferences), with the tamed-swarm modifier.
- 摧毁完成 → 6720：轨道轰炸消灭虫群，留下“纳米残骸”资源点。  
  Destruction → 6720: orbital bombardment leaves a nanite-remains deposit.
- L星门线索：generate_lcluster_clue 在线索集齐时触发共享事件 distar.10904（另一故事）。  
  L-Gate clue: generate_lcluster_clue fires the shared distar.10904 when the clues are complete (another story).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- “驯服虫群”项目描述按首都是否人造星球改变。  
  The Tame the Swarm description changes if the capital is artificial.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：类别、帕尔乌斯初始化器、6700–6720、三个项目、事件链与L星门线索效果。  
  Category, Parvus initializer, 6700–6720, three projects, chain and the L-Gate clue effect.
- 更正 Corrections：6710 原挂在6705之后对所有选项生效；其触发条件要求 studied_nanite_swarm（仅6705.b设置），改为只从“继续研究”连接。  
  6710 was attached to 6705 for every choice; its trigger needs studied_nanite_swarm, set only by 6705.b, so it now links from that choice only.
- 覆盖 Coverage：10 个文档全部核对 / all 10 docs checked.
